text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: C325 · Code listings 7.3–7.6: DEVICE steady-state and transient simulations

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: Chapter 7 — Detectors · Sec. 7.7 Code listings (book pp. 287–291) · Lumerical DEVICE scripts (.lsf)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Listing 7.3 · set up the steady-state (DC) electrical model

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Loads Ge thin-film materials and the shared parameters; redraws the detector geometry.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: The cathode is now aluminium (4× the contact thickness) instead of a perfect conductor.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Adds the imported generation rate (from FDTD), left switched off for now.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Adds the p-epi, p- and n++ doping, and the anode (on the Si) and cathode contacts.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Listing 7.4 · run steady state: dark current and responsivity

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Block 1: dark current at −1 V for 300–360 K, compared with reference data.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Block 2: dark current versus both bias (0 to 2 V) and temperature, as a colour map.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Block 3: light on, bias swept, input 0.9 mW; responsivity = photocurrent / input power.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: As printed, only block 3 is switched on; blocks 1 and 2 are off (if (0)).

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Listing 7.5 · set up the transient model

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Reuses the steady-state setup, switches the solver to transient mode.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Light turns on as a step (step-on shutter); loads the transient generation file.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #64d2ff

g.text: Listing 7.6 · run transient: step, impulse and frequency response

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Loops the anode bias over 0, −0.5, −1 and −2 V; records current versus time (step response).

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Central difference of the step gives the impulse response; its FFT gives frequency response.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #f6f6f6

g.text: Plots normalised response (dB) versus GHz with a −3 dB line, and saves each bias case.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #a1a1a6

g.text: unfold_sim — our reading of the code: only half the width is simulated, so currents are doubled.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Inter', 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #30d158

g.text: Takeaway: DC runs give dark current + responsivity; transient runs give speed (bandwidth).
